basics.name: Junteng Liu
basics.label: Ph.D. candidate in Computer Science, HKUST NLP Group
basics.summary: First-year Ph.D. candidate at the HKUST NLP Group, advised by Prof. Junxian He. Research focuses on natural language processing and machine learning.

education.institution: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

publications.name: SynLogic: Synthesizing Verifiable Reasoning Data at Scale for Learning Logical Reasoning and Beyond
publications.summary: First-authored by Junteng Liu, with Yuanxiang Fan, Zhuo Jiang, Han Ding, Yongyi Hu, Chi Zhang, Yiqi Shi, Shitong Weng, Aili Chen, Shiqi Chen, Yunan Huang, Mozhi Zhang, Pengyu Zhao, Junjie Yan, and Junxian He. Code is available on GitHub.

publications.name: On the Perception Bottleneck of VLMs for Chart Understanding
publications.summary: First-authored by Junteng Liu, with Weihao Zeng, Xiwen Zhang, Yijun Wang, Zifei Shan, and Junxian He. Code is available in the Vision4Chart repository on GitHub.

publications.name: On the Universal Truthfulness Hyperplane Inside LLMs
publications.summary: First-authored by Junteng Liu, with Shiqi Chen, Yu Cheng, and Junxian He. Code is available in the Universal_Truthfulness_Hyperplane repository on GitHub.

publications.name: In-Context Sharpness as Alerts: An Inner Representation Perspective for Hallucination Mitigation
publications.summary: Co-authored by Junteng Liu, with Shiqi Chen, Miao Xiong, Zhengxuan Wu, Teng Xiao, Siyang Gao, and Junxian He.

publications.name: C-Eval: A Multi-Level Multi-Discipline Chinese Evaluation Suite for Foundation Models
publications.summary: Co-authored by Junteng Liu, with Yuzhen Huang, Yuzhuo Bai, Zhihao Zhu, Junlei Zhang, Jinghan Zhang, Tangjun Su, Chuancheng Lv, Yikai Zhang, Jiayi Lei, Yao Fu, Maosong Sun, and Junxian He.

publications.name: Composing Parameter-Efficient Modules with Arithmetic Operations
publications.summary: Co-authored by Junteng Liu, with Jinghan Zhang, Shiqi Chen, and Junxian He.
